onescreen.editor.title: Screen Settings
onescreen.editor.playback.unavailable: Progress control is unavailable for this media
onescreen.editor.refresh_on_resume.toolt: When enabled, closing the single-player pause menu or updating screen settings reconnects a live stream at the live edge. This adds reconnect overhead and is off by default; it only affects live streams.
onescreen.editor.error.no_permission: You need gamemaster permission to edit a screen.
onescreen.editor.error.not_screen: Target block is not a OneScreen frame.
onescreen.editor.error.client_support: The screen editor network channel is unavailable.
onescreen.editor.error.too_far: Move closer to the screen before saving.
onescreen.editor.error.invalid_value: One or more screen values are outside the allowed range.
onescreen.fit.fit.tooltip: Keep the aspect ratio and show the complete picture; unused edges are transparent.
onescreen.fit.stretch.tooltip: Stretch the picture to the full screen without preserving its aspect ratio.
onescreen.fit.tile.tooltip: Keep the aspect ratio and repeat the picture using a one-block reference size.
onescreen.fit.fill.tooltip: Keep the aspect ratio, cover the full screen, and crop any overflow.
onescreen.fit.center.tooltip: Keep the aspect ratio and center the picture at its one-block reference size.
onescreen.command.error.not_screen: Target block is not a OneScreen frame.
onescreen.command.error.no_url: This screen has no URL. Set one before reloading.
onescreen.command.error.invalid_url.inva: URL contains whitespace or invisible control characters.
onescreen.command.error.invalid_url.sche: Only http:// and https:// URLs are allowed.
onescreen.command.error.invalid_url.host: URL must contain a valid host name.
onescreen.command.error.invalid_size: Screen width and height must be finite values from %s to %s blocks.
onescreen.command.error.invalid_render_d: Render distance must be from %s to %s blocks.
onescreen.command.error.invalid_audio_di: Audio distance must be from %s to %s blocks.
onescreen.command.error.invalid_alignmen: Unknown picture position. Use top_left, up, top_right, left, center, right, bottom_left, down, or bottom_right.
onescreen.command.error.invalid_fit_mode: Unknown aspect fit mode. Use fit, stretch, tile, fill, or center.
onescreen.command.error.invalid_volume: Volume must be a finite value from 0.0 to 1.0.
onescreen.command.success.size: Screen %s size set to %s x %s blocks
onescreen.command.success.render_distanc: Screen %s render distance set to %s blocks
onescreen.command.success.audio_distance: Screen %s audio distance set to %s blocks
